236	        const Transport& tr, int64_t slot_off,
237	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dYown, const float* __restrict__ Wshard,
238	        int Kin, int Nout_local,
239	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
240	    dectc::dectc_gemm_dx_f32<N>(dYown, Wshard, tr.local(slot_off),
241	                                Kin, Nout_local, sA, sB);
242	}

245	//  dW under TP — the exact-slice property (NO comm, the P2 machinery carries
246	//  over unchanged). For a COLUMN-parallel weight, the rank's
247	//      dW_own[Nout/P, Kin] = dY_own^T @ X        (X full/replicated)
248	//  is bit-for-bit rows [own_lo, own_hi) of the unsharded dW (same ascending-K
249	//  fp32 contraction over the same T). For a ROW-parallel weight,
250	//      dW_own[Nout, Kin/P] = dY^T @ X_own        (dY full/replicated)
251	//  is bit-for-bit cols [own_lo, own_hi). So P2's output-stationary dW spec for

253	//  rank-local stream/extent — this helper performs that transform. Biases:
254	//  col-parallel db_own = Σ_K dY_own (the own rows of db); row-parallel /
255	//  replicated db = Σ_K dY computed identically on every rank.
256	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
257	__device__ __host__ __forceinline__ void tp_shard_extents(
258	        TpSplit split, int P, int Nout_full, int Kin_full,
259	        int* Nout_local, int* Kin_local) {
260	    switch (split) {
261	        case TpSplit::Col:
262	        case TpSplit::ColQKV: *Nout_local = Nout_full / P; *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
263	        case TpSplit::Row:    *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full / P; break;
264	        default:              *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
265	    }
266	}

268	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
269	//  Symmetric-slot budget for one decoder layer's TP comm, in floats, per tile
270	//  row block of kTileM rows: the largest reduced payload is [kTileM, d] (both
271	//  fwd reduces and both bwd reduces are [rows, d]). The canonical heap plan
272	//  (the loopback binding + the future NVSHMEM bootstrap both size with this):
273	//      slot 0: partial  [kTileM · d]      (publish target)
274	//      slot 1: reduced  [kTileM · d]      (reduce output, when not fused into
275	//                                          a local consumer buffer)
276	//  per CONCURRENT tile in flight per PE. The persistent kernel runs ONE tile
277	//  per CTA at a time ⇒ heap stride = n_ctas_per_pe · 2 · kTileM · d floats.
278	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
279	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_tile_slot_floats() {
280	    return (int64_t)dectc::kTileM * dec::kD;
281	}
282	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_heap_stride_floats(int ctas_per_pe) {
283	    return (int64_t)ctas_per_pe * 2 * tp_tile_slot_floats();
284	}
